source: ParticleSystemComponent templates placed in the stage maps (_geom, _reload, _demo, _effect)
limitations: GPU floor collision of KO debris is not reproduced (debris passes the floor)
dynamic material parameters other than AlphaClip (scroll, distortion) are not reproduced
large smoke sprites are capped at 60/s
vector fields are approximated: tightness as drag, intensity as noise (field shapes not decoded)
